
[yellow bold]-- DEPRECATION -- gpio_15_strapping_warns.volt:2[/yellow bold]

Move `chip esp8266` to volt.toml: chip = "esp8266"

 [dim]1 |[/dim] 
 [dim]2 |[/dim] chip esp8266
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]     ^^^^^^^[/yellow]

[cyan]Hint: The chip declaration will move to volt.toml in a future version.[/cyan]


[yellow bold]-- HARDWARE WARNING -- gpio_15_strapping_warns.volt:4[/yellow bold]

Strapping pin: GPIO 15 must be LOW during boot. If HIGH, chip boots from SD card (not flash).

 [dim]3 |[/dim] hardware {
 [dim]4 |[/dim]     pin x: Output = 15
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]        ^[/yellow]
